questions.source_label: Chapter 5.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text:
Exploit the symmetries of the right triangle to evaluate the following sum entirely in your head:
$\cos^2 10^\circ + \cos^2 20^\circ + \cos^2 30^\circ + \cos^2 40^\circ + \cos^2 50^\circ + \cos^2 60^\circ + \cos^2 70^\circ + \cos^2 80^\circ$
An angle \(\theta\) satisfies \(\sin\theta+\cos\theta=\frac13\), and \(\theta\) lies in Quadrant II. Find the exact value of \(\tan\theta\).

questions.text:
Using the reciprocal properties of inverse trigonometric functions, evaluate the exact value of:
$$ \sin\left(\sec^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{4}\right) + \csc^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)\right) $$
